# SalesCard

> SalesCard is the verified sales performance record for sales professionals — SDRs, BDRs, and Account Executives. Reps upload their last eight quarters of sales metrics in about 90 seconds and get a verified card: a normalized 1-100 score, a peer percentile ranking, and a shareable profile that follows them between jobs. Free for reps, forever. Tagline: "Your sales career. Finally on the back of a card."

## Key facts

- What it is: a verified, portable sales performance record — "resumes are stories, cards are stats"
- Who it's for: SDRs, BDRs, and AEs who want their numbers to travel with them, and recruiters who want to shortlist from verified quota attainment instead of resume adjectives
- How it works: upload 8 quarters of metrics → verification → normalized 1-100 score + percentile vs. thousands of reps → shareable card
- Price: free for sales reps
- Founder: Chad Burmeister (https://www.chadburmeister.com/) — sales leader, author, host of The AI for Sales Podcast
- App: https://app.salescard.ai/ (sign-in and card claim)

## For recruiters

- [SalesCard for Recruiters](https://salescard.ai/recruiters.html): verify any candidate's last 8 quarters, search a pool of reps with verified numbers, place faster with a 60-day "place one or pay nothing" guarantee
- Positioning: "LinkedIn Recruiter shows you titles. SalesCard shows you receipts."
